item.title: 在 OpenRouter 上，AI 支出增长已趋于平缓至 0%。为期 4 周的代币交易量仍增长 39%，
item.description:
在 OpenRouter 上，AI 支出增长已趋于平缓至 0%。为期 4 周的代币交易量仍增长 39%，低于夏末的 75%，这表明使用量正在放缓。最重要的是，随着企业将节省的资金收入囊中，每个代币的价格今年迄今已下跌 83%，导致代币弹性从 5.4（第一季度）→ 5.5（第二季度）→ 1.6（第三季度）→ 1.2（第四季度）下降。

不过，历史提醒我们要谨慎：弹性在 2024 年 12 月和 2025 年 11 月也曾降至 1 左右，然后在主要车型发布后反弹。这是持久的转变还是只是波浪之间的平静，取决于下一个突破。

On OpenRouter, AI spend growth has flattened to 0%. Four-week token volume is still up 39%, down from ~75% in late summer—signaling decelerating usage. Most importantly, per-token prices have fallen 83% YTD, driving token elasticity down from 5.4 (Q1) → 5.5 (Q2) → 1.6 (Q3) → 1.2 (Q4) as enterprises pocket the savings.

History urges caution, though: elasticity also dipped to ~1 in Dec 2024 and Nov 2025 before rebounding on major model launches. Whether this is a lasting shift or just a lull between waves hinges on the next breakthrough.

item.description:
⚖️黄仁勋宣布卸任后，多数机构目标价下跌30%左右。迄今为止的下调主要针对市盈率，而利润预期尚未下调。

这使得这是一次性降级，而在降级中最重要的变量是不确定性何时上升。一旦明朗的明天会比今天更好，疫情和关税冲击就会以同样的方式触底。黄周一晚上的回归带来了快速反弹，一些情绪指标现在显示超卖。不过，机构可能仍会在年底前保持防御性，而散户投资者仍在去杠杆化，因此一次解决的事件远不足以完全扭转局面。

我们在 8 月份指出了 CSP 的现金流压力，并在 9 月份指出了债务、收益率和外汇方面的三大风险。这次修正的规模仍然远远超出了我们的预期，因为我们自始至终都对人工智能持建设性态度。经过充分研究的电话会议与我们实际可以承受的风险之间的差距是我们的首席执行官本月信中的大部分内容。

📥 本月的 CEO House View 回顾了人工智能的制造、融资和生产力周期，提出了市场稳定的三个条件（其中一个已经清除），并以涵盖崩溃、触底过程和复苏的 2027 年复苏路线图作为结束。

🔗 完整报告：https://en.macromicro.me/blog/ceo-house-view-humility-risk-after-the-nvidia-selloff-revisiting-ai-s- Three-cycles

⚖️ After Jensen Huang's announcement that he would step down, most institutional target prices fell about 30%. The cuts so far land on P/E multiples, and profit estimates have not been cut.

That makes this a one-time de-rating, and in a de-rating the variable that matters most is when the uncertainty lifts. The pandemic and the tariff shocks bottomed the same way, once it became clear that tomorrow would be better than today. Huang's return on Monday evening produced a quick bounce, and several sentiment gauges now read oversold. Institutions may still stay defensive into year-end, though, and retail investors are still deleveraging, so one resolved event falls well short of a full turnaround.

We pointed out cash-flow pressure at the CSPs in August and three risks across debt, yields and FX in September. The size of this correction still went well beyond what we expected, because we had been constructive on AI throughout. That gap between a well-researched call and the risk we could actually absorb is where our CEO spent most of this month's letter.

📥 This month's CEO House View walks through AI's manufacturing, financing and productivity cycles, sets out three conditions for the market to stabilize (one has already cleared), and closes with a 2027 recovery roadmap covering the crash, the bottoming process and the recovery.

item.description:

早在 9 月下旬，甲骨文就因天然气管道和电网许可延误而向开发商在新墨西哥州 Jupiter 站点发出了不可抗力通知。如果到 2028 年园区还没有上线，Oracle 可以推迟支付租金。该项目通过甲骨文长期租赁支持的第三方 SPV 承担了约 18B 美元的债务，这是跨越三个甲骨文和 OpenAI 计算站点的全球银行银团建设贷款计划的一部分：威斯康星州（Lighthouse）和德克萨斯州（Frontier）总计 38B 美元，加上 Jupiter 的 18B 美元。

11 月份发布的报告显示，银行已经在出售该票据。汇丰银行以 85 美分的价格出售了 3 亿美元的 Jupiter 高级贷款，ING 拍卖了包含 Jupiter 债务的 5 亿美元一揽子计划，法国兴业银行正试图出售 3 亿美元的威斯康星州和德克萨斯州项目债券。木星实际上只是这里的触发器。市场实际上担心的是甲骨文的长期现金流以及他们对OpenAI的依赖程度。

上周五（11 月 20 日）收盘后，甲骨文发表了一份罕见的声明，称他们已于本月早些时候完成了最后一轮融资，使其成为本投资周期中第一家“获得全额资助”的超大规模企业。他们声称，包括供应商融资在内的一切都已锁定，并且 OpenAI 合同的交付将不依赖于额外的附带交易。在扩建方面，他们表示 Abilene (Astra-6) 已接近完工，Shackelford GW 规模的场地已获得所有许可，NVIDIA Vera Rubin 机架将在未来几周内抵达。他们还坚持在 2028 财年 2 季度将自由现金流转为正数的目标，并在 2029 财年实现自由现金流超过 30B 美元。一个问题是德克萨斯州当选州长伊诺霍萨早些时候呼吁暂停数据中心，这给他们 2027-28 年之后的扩张计划增加了另一个变量。

然而，这些都没有让债券持有人放心。昨天，甲骨文 6.7% 无抵押 2056 债券跌至 76.295，收益率接近 9%，G 利差（相对于 30 年期国债）为 372.8 个基点。 5Y CDS 扩大到超过 360 bps，远高于其他四个超大规模提供商：MSFT 为 50 bps，GOOGL 为 87 bps，AMZN 为 98 bps，META 为 119 bps。信贷显然正在重新定价甲骨文的违约风险。

这符合我们在债券市场看到的更广泛的分裂，压力正在加剧，导致高收益债券走弱。 CCC 与 BB 的利差接近 1,000 个基点，这是我们仅在 2020 年大流行、2015-16 年页岩油泡沫破裂和 2008 年期间见过的水平。同时，BBB 与 AA 的利差保持在 50 个基点附近，因此 IG 看起来仍然相对稳定。部分原因在于指数组合：$AMZN、GOOGL、$META 和 $NVDA 目前约占美国 AA 债券池的 35%，将修正久期延长至 7.6 年。所有这些供应正在推动 AA 价差扩大，并缩小与 BBB 的相对差距。

Even with Jensen Huang back, AI financing issues haven't gone away. The stress has just moved from CoreWeave to Oracle.

Back in late September, Oracle hit developers with a force majeure notice on its New Mexico Jupiter site over gas pipeline and grid permit delays. If the campus isn't online by 2028, Oracle can push back rent payments. The project carries around $18B in debt through a third-party SPV backed by Oracle's long-term lease, which is part of a global bank syndicate construction loan package across three Oracle and OpenAI compute sites: $38B total for Wisconsin (Lighthouse) and Texas (Frontier), plus $18B for Jupiter.

Reports out in November show banks are already offloading this paper. HSBC dumped $300M of Jupiter senior loans at 85 cents on the dollar, ING auctioned a $500M package with Jupiter debt in it, and SocGen is trying to move $300M in Wisconsin and Texas project bonds. Jupiter is really just the trigger here. What the market is actually worried about is Oracle's long-term cash flow and how reliant they are on OpenAI.

After the close last Friday (Nov 20), Oracle put out a rare statement saying they wrapped up their final funding round earlier this month, making them the first hyperscaler "fully funded" for this investment cycle. They claimed everything, vendor financing included, is locked in and delivering on OpenAI contracts won't depend on extra side deals. On the buildout front, they said Abilene (Astra-6) is almost finished, the Shackelford GW-scale site has all its permits, and NVIDIA Vera Rubin racks are arriving in the coming weeks. They also stuck with their target of turning FCF positive in 2H FY28 and hitting over $30B in FCF by FY29. One catch is Texas Governor-elect Hinojosa's earlier call for a data center moratorium, which adds another variable to their expansion plans past 2027-28.

None of it has reassured bondholders, however. Yesterday, Oracle's 6.7% unsecured 2056 bonds slid to 76.295, putting the yield close to 9% and the G-spread (over the 30Y Treasury) at 372.8 bps. 5Y CDS widened past 360 bps, way above the other four hyperscalers: MSFT at 50 bps, GOOGL at 87 bps, AMZN at 98 bps, and META at 119 bps. Credit is clearly repricing Oracle's default risk.

It fits the broader split we're seeing in the bond market, where stress is piling into weaker high yield. CCC to BB spreads are sitting near 1,000 bps, levels we've only seen during the 2020 pandemic, the 2015-16 shale bust, and 2008. Meanwhile, BBB to AA spreads are holding near 50 bps, so IG still looks relatively stable. Part of that comes down to index mix: $AMZN, GOOGL , $META, and $NVDA now make up an estimated 35% of the US AA bond pool, stretching modified duration out to 7.6 years. All that supply is pushing AA spreads wider and squeezing the relative gap against BBBs.

item.title: 🇺🇸 今天晚些时候发布的 10 月 PCE 不太可能改变美联储 12 月的计划，但它将揭示之后的
item.description:
🇺🇸 今天晚些时候发布的 10 月 PCE 不太可能改变美联储 12 月的计划，但它将揭示之后的路径。这将是我们获得的 10 月份唯一的同比通胀数据，因为消费者物价指数 (CPI) 没有。预测总体增长率为 3.8%，核心增长率为 3.2%，高于 3.6% 和 3.1%。

大多数在过去两周发表言论的选民都认为 12 月加息 25 个基点。威廉姆斯表示，前景并不需要采取戏剧性的行动，哈马克更喜欢小规模、更频繁的加息，尽管她和库克反对十月份的加息。沃勒是个例外：他希望 12 月加息 50 个基点，除非委员会暗示 1 月份再次加息。

美联储目前关注的焦点是通胀，但融资条件正在收紧，特别是在人工智能抛售之后，这增加了美联储更快转向的可能性。我们看到两条路。首先，股市大幅下跌，美联储完成 12 月加息并暂停。第二，它继续攀升至明年第一季度。不管怎样，去年 3 月份的能源价格涨幅与 3 月份相比已经回落，因此通胀数据将会下降，我们预计美联储将在第二季度转为观望。

🇺🇸 October PCE later today is unlikely to change the Fed's plans for December, but it will shed light on the path after. It'll be the only year-over-year inflation reading we get for October, as CPI had none. Forecasts are 3.8% headline and 3.2% core, up from 3.6% and 3.1%.

Most voters who have spoken in the past two weeks sit at a 25bp hike in December. Williams said the outlook doesn't call for dramatic action, and Hammack prefers smaller, more frequent hikes even though she and Cook dissented for a hike in October. Waller is the exception: he wants 50bp in December unless the Committee signals another hike in January.

The Fed is focused on inflation for now, but financing conditions are tightening, particularly after the AI sell-off, and that raises the chance it pivots sooner. We see two paths. In the first, equities fall sharply, the Fed completes its December hike and pauses. In the second, it keeps hiking into Q1 next year. Either way, last March's energy price jump drops out of the year-over-year comparison from March, so inflation readings will fall, and we expect the Fed to turn to wait-and-see in Q2.

item.title: 🗺️ CPO 模块制造商和一些服务器组装商高达 85% 的收入来自 GPU 客户，其中大部分是 Nv
item.description:
🗺️ CPO 模块制造商和一些服务器组装商高达 85% 的收入来自 GPU 客户，其中大部分是 Nvidia，这就是为什么这些股票在 Nvidia 领导层变动的消息传出后就会出现波动，尽管 Nvidia 自己的数据不断改善。 Vera Rubin 第一季度营收接近 200 亿美元，2027 年全年增长指引从 70% 升至 75%，供应链采购承诺从 2790 亿美元升至 3900 亿美元。黄昨天的回归稳定了这一切，但市场已经停止自动为产能瓶颈买单。

1 月至 9 月，全球半导体销售额达到 1.24 兆美元，增长 123%，这意味着到 2027 年，每个节点都必须在更高的基础上增长，而拥有一个主要客户的供应商几乎没有空间吸收单个延迟订单、设计修改或内部 ASIC 损失的份额。对远程计算的出口管制和对数据中心能源使用日益严格的审查增加了这种风险。

我们预计 2027 年整个链条将出现分歧，分界线是第二个客户是否可以在第一个客户放缓的时候介入。一些细分市场已经顺利通过了这一测试，而另一些细分市场的估值则假设收入将在 2028 年或 2029 年实现。

📥 Outlook 2027 系列的第四部分根据丢失的 Nvidia 订单被替换的速度将供应链分为两组，列出每组中的细分市场，并显示每个细分市场的收入中有多少来自 GPU 客户。它还涵盖 12 月 1 日的听证会、12 月 4 日的 10-Q 截止日期以及 1 月至 6 月期间的交易和许可截止日期。

🔗 全面展望：https://en.macromicro.me/blog/outlook-2027-series-iv-huang-is-back-but-is-the-ai-market-s-faith-sorting-the-2027-supply-chain

🗺️ Up to 85% of revenue at CPO module makers and some server assemblers comes from GPU customers, mostly Nvidia, which is why those stocks moved the moment news of Nvidia's leadership changes broke, even though Nvidia's own numbers kept improving. Vera Rubin generated close to US$20bn in its first quarter, full-year 2027 growth guidance went from 70% to 75%, and supply chain purchase commitments rose from US$279bn to US$390bn. Huang's return yesterday steadied all of it, yet the market has stopped paying automatically for a capacity bottleneck.

Global semiconductor sales reached US$1.24tn in January to September, up 123%, which means every node has to grow off a much higher base in 2027, and a supplier with one dominant customer has little room to absorb a single delayed order, a design revision or share lost to in-house ASICs. Export controls on remote compute and rising scrutiny of data center energy use add to that exposure.

We expect 2027 to bring divergence across the chain, with the dividing line being whether a second customer can step in the day the first one slows down. Some segments already pass that test comfortably, while others carry valuations that assume revenue arriving in 2028 or 2029.

📥 Part IV of our Outlook 2027 series divides the supply chain into two groups by how quickly a lost Nvidia order gets replaced, lists the segments in each, and shows how much of each segment's revenue comes from GPU customers. It also covers the December 1 hearing, the December 4 10-Q deadline, and the trade and licensing deadlines falling between January and June.

item.title: 🦢 半决赛中罕见的白天鹅：黄仁勋将重返 $NVDA，该股盘前涨幅超过 30%。 11 月 23 日
item.description:
🦢 半决赛中罕见的白天鹅：黄仁勋将重返 $NVDA，该股盘前涨幅超过 30%。 11 月 23 日晚，英伟达宣布董事会一致投票决定立即恢复詹森担任总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员。这让过去两周令科技界和华尔街感到不安的董事会政变和辞职大戏暂停了。就在表示无意让他回归后几天，董事会就做出了 180 度大转弯。眼前的领导危机已经结束，但合规性和 DC 悬而未决的问题还没有解决。

好消息是“无领导”折扣已经消失。 Nvidia 处于大规模人工智能基础设施建设的中心，而 Jensen 不仅仅是一个傀儡。他拥有技术路线图并将供应链粘合在一起。让他快速回归可以消除因继任缺口或战略漂移而产生的恐慌。更重要的是，他获得了华盛顿的国家安全绿灯。新闻稿明确表示，董事会咨询了美国高级官员，并相信詹森的回归对国家安全构成零风险。政府的掩护显然让董事会有勇气如此迅速地转变。

也就是说，未来两周内仍有三件事可能会爆发。首先是延迟的 10-Q 的 12 月 4 日截止日期。推迟第三季度的官方文件已经让英伟达的内部审计和会计受到了密切关注。华尔街正在关注他们是否真的以干净、无保留的意见让 SEC 截止，以及该文件是否会删除有关内部调查或相关交易（如传闻中的 Megaspeed 调查）的新数据。

接下来是 12 月 1 日的国会听证会。詹森同意出庭作证。白宫和行政部门可能已经悄悄签署，但国会，尤其是对华鹰派和银行委员会，在公开听证会上不会手下留情。预计芯片出口漏洞和外国情报接触将受到尖锐拷问，这很容易成为短期波动的催化剂。
最后，独立调查尚未结束，SEC 仍在潜伏。由独立董事和外部法律顾问组成的特别委员会正在完成审查，英伟达仍在配合政府调查。在最终报告发布之前，总体风险仍然很高，包括美国证券交易委员会可能对信息披露或内部控制进行的审查。

底线：詹森的回归稳定了基本面和领导地位，这显然有助于近期情绪。但 12 月 1 日的 Hill 活动和 12 月 4 日的 10-Q 活动是两个真正的清算事件，决定 Nvidia 是否真正摆脱困境。

🦢 Rare white swan in semis: Jensen Huang is heading back to $NVDA , and the stock is ripping 30%+ premarket. Late on Nov 23, Nvidia announced the board voted unanimously to immediately reinstate Jensen as President, CEO, and board member. That puts a pause on the boardroom coup and resignation drama that has rattled tech and the Street for the past two weeks. Just days after signaling they had no intention of bringing him back, the board pulled a full 180. The immediate leadership crisis is over, though the compliance and DC overhang isn't going anywhere yet.

The good news is the "leaderless" discount is gone. Nvidia is dead center in a massive AI infra buildout, and Jensen isn't just a figurehead. He owns the tech roadmap and keeps the supply chain glued together. Getting him back fast kills the panic around a succession gap or strategic drift. Even bigger, he got a national security green light from Washington. The release explicitly says the board consulted senior U.S. officials and is confident Jensen's return poses zero national security risk. That cover from the administration is clearly what gave the board the nerve to flip so fast.

That said, there are still three things that could blow up over the next two weeks. First is the Dec 4 deadline for the delayed 10-Q. Holding back the official Q3 filing has already put Nvidia's internal audits and accounting under a microscope. The Street is watching to see if they actually make the SEC cutoff with a clean, unqualified opinion, and whether the filing drops new numbers on internal probes or related deals like the rumored Megaspeed investigation.

Next is the Dec 1 congressional hearing. Jensen agreed to testify on the Hill. The White House and executive branch might have signed off quietly, but Congress, especially the China hawks and Banking Committee, doesn't pull punches in public hearings. Expect pointed grilling on chip export loopholes and foreign intelligence contacts, which is an easy catalyst for short-term vol.
Finally, the independent probe isn't closed, and the SEC is still lurking. The special committee of independent directors and outside counsel are finishing their review, and Nvidia is still cooperating with government inquiries. Until that final report drops, headline risk stays high, including potential SEC scrutiny over disclosures or internal controls.

Bottom line: getting Jensen back steadies the fundamentals and the leadership, which clearly helps near-term sentiment. But Dec 1 on the Hill and Dec 4 for the 10-Q are the two real clearing events that decide whether Nvidia actually walks away clean from this.

item.title: 🔏 Nvidia 在整个 AI 生态系统中的购买承诺已从 $279B 攀升至 $390B。第三季度自由现
item.description:
🔏 Nvidia 在整个 AI 生态系统中的购买承诺已从 $279B 攀升至 $390B。第三季度自由现金流几乎翻了一番，达到 $43.78B，为公司提供了继续为扩张提供资金的空间。但资产负债表在为人工智能建设融资方面发挥着越来越大的作用。

英伟达越来越多地充当其客户和供应商网络中的金融中介。股权投资、云协议、购买承诺和贷款担保都是该安排的一部分。该模型使资本在生态系统中流动，资金最终随着 GPU 订单返回英伟达。

问题是这笔融资有多少取决于客户实际将数据中心上线。例如，CoreWeave 拥有 3.1GW 的合同产能，但只有约 1.1GW 已通电。其将合同产能转化为收入的能力在很大程度上取决于电力供应和建设时间表。

这使得人工智能行业的下一阶段面临着不同的压力。芯片需求依然强劲，但支持该需求的融资结构值得更密切的审查。

在本周的评论中，我们通过担保、客户承诺和 Neocloud 关系来追踪 Nvidia 的财务风险，以及可能揭示新兴信贷压力的借贷成本和电力部署数据。我们还研究了 Anthropic 1.5T 的 IPO 及其盈利之路背后的计算经济学，以及美联储日益强硬的立场对进入 12 月的市场意味着什么。

🔗 完整报告：https://en.macromicro.me/blog/wefc-chip-off-your-shoulder-pdf-download

🔏 Nvidia's purchase commitments across the AI ecosystem have climbed to $390B, up from $279B. Free cash flow nearly doubled to $43.78B in Q3, giving the company room to keep funding the expansion. But the balance sheet is taking on a growing role in financing the AI buildout.

Nvidia is increasingly acting as a financial intermediary across its customer and supplier network. Equity investments, cloud agreements, purchase commitments and loan guarantees are all part of the arrangement. The model keeps capital flowing through the ecosystem, with money eventually returning to Nvidia as GPU orders.

The question is how much of this financing depends on customers actually getting their data centers online. CoreWeave, for example, has 3.1GW of contracted capacity, but only around 1.1GW is energized. Its ability to convert contracted capacity into revenue depends heavily on power availability and construction timelines.

That puts the next phase of the AI trade under a different set of pressures. Chip demand remains strong, but the financing structure supporting that demand deserves closer scrutiny.

In this week's commentary, we trace Nvidia's financial exposure through its guarantees, customer commitments and Neocloud relationships, alongside the borrowing costs and power deployment data that could reveal emerging credit stress. We also examine Anthropic's $1.5T IPO and the compute economics behind its path to profitability, as well as what the Fed's increasingly hawkish stance means for markets heading into December.
